historical_references.reference: Divyasura or Divyadatta was a powerful demon king in Hindu mythology, believed to have been born during the Mahabharata period. He was known for his immense strength and intelligence, and was a devoted follower of Lord Shiva. Divyasura is said to have wreaked havoc in the three realms of Heaven, Earth, and Netherworld, until he was eventually slain by the Pandava brothers Bhima and Arjuna.
historical_references.context: Hindu mythology, demon king, devoted follower of Lord Shiva, wreaked havoc in three realms, slain by Pandava brothers Bhima and Arjuna

historical_references.reference: Divakaruni Mishra, also known as Divyadharshan, was a renowned Hindu scholar and philosopher of the 19th century. He was born in Bengal, India, and is best known for his work 'Saraswati-Sahitya-Samgraha', a comprehensive study of Indian literature. Divyadharshan is considered a pioneer in the field of Indian literary criticism and is regarded as one of the greatest scholars of his time.
historical_references.context: Renowned Hindu scholar and philosopher, Indian literature, comprehensive study, Indian literary criticism, greatest scholars of his time
